notes: Machine form of the one MCP standard (L1 tools, L2 resources, L3 mapping). The site core/mcp registry must register every tool below with the same name, mode, scopes and confirm; bin/validate-mcp-standard.mjs checks code markers `@mcp bizcity-mcp-standard@1 tool <name>` against this file. `llm_alias` = the key the cell exposes to the model (Q88-5: existing cell keys are kept). `fallback_pack` = projection pack the cell reads when the MCP call times out or fails (owner/staff turns) and the only source on customer turns. `wave` = PHASE-0.88 wave that ships it. EXTENSION ARM (2026-10-05, R-VA-10..14 / R-BCB-8, contract automation-scenario@1): business capability the cell has no builtin tool for is declared as a SCENARIO at the client, reached through ONE tool family (automation.list_scenarios / automation.run_scenario, PHASE-0.91 AX-1). Rule for this file: a write tool that does a BACKGROUND job and has a default scenario must carry `system: true` (one door per job); reads and in-turn writes (order.create, booking.create) keep their own model-visible tools. STANDING AUTHORISATION (2026-10-05, D91-31, exception to Q88-1/L1-7 'the wrapper owns the token, handlers never do'): a write whose authorisation is already STORED AS DATA by the site owner - who authorised it and when - counts as confirmed, so confirm_gate() honours `auto_confirm` returned by preview() and runs straight away while still writing the audit row (confirm: standing, authorized_by). Today the only holder of such data is an automation scenario with `cell.confirm: 'never'` + `cell.standing_auth {by, at, label}`, settable only with manage_options and revocable at any time; no other tool may return auto_confirm.

tools.name: cf7.form.create
tools.notes: PHASE-0.118 S118-L6 (2026-10-16): creates ONE Contact Form 7 form from a form-spec@1 (≤ 8 text/email/tel/textarea fields); mail goes to the requesting person's own email. System tool: only the cell's builtin create_landing_page calls it. Hidden when Contact Form 7 is not installed.

tools.name: wp.landing.draft
tools.notes: PHASE-0.118 S118-L5 (2026-10-16): builds ONE landing page as a DRAFT from a page-spec@1 (hero/benefits/text/form/cta). Flatsome ⇒ UX Builder shortcodes, other theme ⇒ Gutenberg. Never publishes. System tool: only the cell's builtin create_landing_page calls it.

tools.name: wp.page.publish
tools.notes: PHASE-0.118 S118-L7 (2026-10-17): publishes ONE page that the assistant built (wp.landing.draft, meta _bizcity_generated) and that is still not public. R2: confirm ALWAYS (preview with the public address + confirm_token bound to the arguments), needs publish_pages and edit_post of that page. System tool: only the cell's builtin publish_landing_page calls it.

tools.name: wp.site.info
tools.notes: PHASE-0.118 S118-L4 (2026-10-17 02:09 PM): read-only site facts (name, theme, page transports flatsome/gutenberg, Contact Form 7, the caller's page capabilities). PageBuilder is reported only as an optional extension (D118-23). Model-visible.

tools.name: wp.content.list
tools.notes: PHASE-0.118 S118-L4 (2026-10-17 02:09 PM): read-only list of pages/posts (≤ 20); admins see all, others only their own; a draft never exposes an address. Model-visible.

tools.name: cf7.form.list
tools.notes: PHASE-0.118 S118-L4 (2026-10-17 02:09 PM): read-only list of Contact Form 7 forms (id, title, shortcode, ≤ 30). Hidden when CF7 is not installed. Model-visible.

tools.name: wp.page.read
tools.notes: PHASE-0.118 S118-L5 (2026-10-17 02:16 PM): read the sections of ONE assistant-built page (indexed from 0) + spec_hash; any other page returns needs_human + the WordPress edit link. Model-visible.

tools.name: wp.page.history
tools.notes: PHASE-0.118 S118-L11 (2026-10-17): site-change-log@1 of ONE assistant-built page: newest first (max 20) when/what/who/how approved (manual|standing|none)/changes/command_line (display only, never run)/before_ref+after_ref (snapshot ids)/can_restore. Detail lives in the page meta history; the MCP audit gets one metadata-only line per change. Model-visible.

tools.name: wp.theme.info
tools.notes: PHASE-0.118 W4 (2026-10-17): the active theme (Flatsome supported?), the WHITELIST of changeable theme_mods with current values and limits, and the last 10 changes (change_id, revertable). Model-visible.

tools.name: wp.theme.update
tools.notes: PHASE-0.118 W4 (2026-10-17): changes up to 8 whitelisted theme_mods, or reverts one logged change. R2: confirm ALWAYS (preview old -> new + confirm_token bound to the arguments); needs edit_theme_options. The previous values are kept (option bizcity_selfwp_theme_changes, max 20) and a revert is itself revertable. No CSS/JS/HTML key is in the whitelist. System tool: the cell builtin update_theme_settings is its only door.

tools.name: cf7.form.update
tools.notes: PHASE-0.118 S118-L6 (2026-10-17): edits ONE assistant-built Contact Form 7 form (fields, labels, button, thank-you text) from a partial form-spec, or restores a snapshot. The recipient is read back and written back untouched; recipient_email is refused (use cf7.form.set_recipient). The previous spec is kept (max 10, 90 days). A hand-made form answers selfwp_form_not_generated + the WordPress link. Model-visible.

tools.name: cf7.form.set_recipient
tools.notes: PHASE-0.118 S118-L8 (2026-10-17): the ONLY door that changes where an assistant-built form mails the visitor data. R2: confirm ALWAYS (preview shows old -> new address, both masked; token bound to the arguments); one address only; the previous address is kept (last 5) so revert=true can put it back; history and audit carry masked addresses. System tool: the cell builtin change_form_recipient is its only door.

tools.name: wp.user.create
tools.notes: PHASE-0.118 W4 S118-L9 (2026-10-17): R3 - creates ONE WordPress account with a role in {subscriber, customer, contributor, author, editor} (never administrator / shop_manager). Owner principal only, mode site_admin, needs create_users. confirm ALWAYS every time (preview + token bound to the arguments), never schedulable / standing. No password is created, returned or logged: WordPress mails the person its set-password link. Emails masked everywhere. System tool: the cell builtin create_website_account is its only door.

tools.name: wp.user.set_role
tools.notes: PHASE-0.118 W4 S118-L9 (2026-10-17): R3 - moves ONE account between the same five roles. Owner principal only, mode site_admin, needs promote_users + promote_user (that account). Refuses yourself, administrators / super admins and anyone whose current role is outside the list. confirm ALWAYS every time. System tool: the cell builtin set_website_account_role is its only door.

tools.name: wp.page.draft
tools.notes: PHASE-0.118 S118-L5 (2026-10-18): creates ONE plain page as a DRAFT from a page-spec@1 (no landing template, the theme header / footer stay); idempotency_key is mandatory so a retry never opens a second page; never public (publish is wp.page.publish). Model-visible.

tools.name: wp.page.attach_form
tools.notes: PHASE-0.118 S118-L5 (2026-10-18): adds ONE existing Contact Form 7 form to a DRAFT page the assistant built (an add-section edit through wp.page.edit: same rights, snapshot and history); the same form twice is a quiet no-op. Model-visible.

tools.name: wp.media.upload
tools.notes: PHASE-0.118 S118-L5 (2026-10-18): stores ONE picture (JPEG / PNG / GIF / WebP, max 1.5 MB, max 8000 px) into the media library. The bytes travel inside the call (data_base64); no URL is ever accepted or fetched (no SSRF). The type comes from the content, never the name; SVG / HTML / PHP and pictures carrying script markers are refused; same bytes = same media id. Needs upload_files. System tool: its cell door (taking the picture from the chat file store) is still to be built.

tools.name: wp.menu.list
tools.notes: PHASE-0.118 S118-L8 (2026-10-18): the navigation menus (id, name, locations) with their items (item_id, title, parent, page or address) and the last menu changes (change_id). Read-only companion of wp.menu.update (the model needs item_id). Model-visible.

tools.name: wp.menu.update
tools.notes: PHASE-0.118 S118-L8 (2026-10-18): edits ONE menu with up to 10 operations (add / remove / move / rename) or reverts one logged change. R2: confirm ALWAYS (diff preview + token bound to the arguments). Max 40 items, 2 levels; a link is a PUBLISHED page of the site, an internal path or an http(s) address with a real host (no IP literal, no javascript:/data:/mailto:/tel:). The previous structure is saved BEFORE the write (option bizcity_selfwp_menu_changes, max 20); the audit line carries no titles or addresses. System tool: the cell builtin update_site_menu is its only door.

tools.name: wp.page.edit
tools.notes: PHASE-0.118 S118-L5 (2026-10-17 02:16 PM): edit ONE assistant-built DRAFT page section by section (≤ 10 ops: set_title/update/add/remove) on the spec stored when it was built; optimistic lock via base_spec_hash; never publishes; published or hand-written pages are refused / needs_human. Model-visible.

tools.name: wp.page.update_live
tools.notes: PHASE-0.118 S118-L7 (2026-10-17): edits ONE PUBLIC page that the assistant built, section by section (same ops as wp.page.edit), on the spec stored with the page. R2: confirm ALWAYS (preview = section diff + confirm_token bound to the arguments); base_spec_hash is required (optimistic lock, a stale read is a 409); needs publish_pages AND edit_post of that page. The previous version is kept as a snapshot (max 10, 90 days) so wp.page.restore can undo it. Never changes the publish status. System tool: the cell builtin (S118-B) will be its only door.

tools.name: wp.page.restore
tools.notes: PHASE-0.118 S118-L7 (2026-10-17): puts ONE assistant-built page back to a snapshot (snapshot_id from wp.page.read). R2: confirm ALWAYS (preview = diff). snapshot_id is mandatory so a retried call can never undo the undo; the version it replaces becomes a snapshot too. A public page also needs publish_pages. Snapshots are re-validated like a fresh spec. Never changes the publish status. System tool.

knowledge_tools.notes: Every tool that reads or writes the brain spine declares a `brain` block in its register() call: exactly one of `tier` (L1 journal · L2 embed · L3 KG — document / notebook-source knowledge only) or `layer` (twin_sheet · job · skill · notebook · output · document rows), `permission` (a brain-access@1 permission the tool needs, checked at the source), `crud` (read|write|state; L2/L3 read only — learning is a job), `answer_hint` (instant|detail|graph, required for a tier tool). The spec calls the data tier `tier`, but tool-registry@1 already owns that key (cell|site|channel), so the block is `_meta.bizcity.brain`. A tool takes no `audience` argument: the site derives the scope from the principal. Results carry tier|layer + next_tier_available + audience_applied. `exempt` = tools of the notebook mode that are not brain-data answers.

existing_tool_modes.notes: Modes for tools registered before 0.88 so a delegated (cell) principal can reach them by mode. Tools not listed here (document.*, page.*, content.*, brain.context.*) are not offered to delegated principals in 0.88.
